retries_and_errors.error: Each view needs a direction vector
retries_and_errors.resolution: Read runtime_ops.py source; replaced preset name strings with explicit [x,y,z] direction vectors

ambiguities.description: rhino_create_document has no 'name' parameter. The tool generates a UUID-based temp filename. POC document identity (RHINO_CHATGPT_BRIDGE_POC_004) is established only at rhino_save_as time. Operators cannot set a display name in the GUI at creation time via this tool.

rhino_save_as 'SaveAs' mode writes the file to the target path but does not update the document's active path in Rhino's GUI (active_document_path_after still shows the temp path). The document is identified as RHINO_CHATGPT_BRIDGE_POC_004 by its saved artifact path, not by its in-Rhino name.

rhino_validate_assembly tested_pairs=0 for 3 stacked objects. The stacked geometry (touching at faces but not volumetrically overlapping) produces 0 candidate pairs in the broad-phase bbox overlap test. This is correct behavior — no interference — but an operator unfamiliar with the tool's narrow intersection test may interpret 0 tested_pairs as 'check did not run'.

archive_scene=true in rhino_capture_views did not produce a separate .3dm scene archive. The parameter appears defined in the tool schema but the tool's output did not include an archive path. Scene archive was instead obtained via rhino_save_as.

friction_points.title: rhino_capture_views requires explicit direction vectors; preset name strings not supported
friction_points.description: The tool schema description says 'Capture arbitrary camera presets' but the runtime requires direction:[x,y,z] dicts, not named presets like 'iso' or 'top'. An operator who passes {preset:'iso'} or {name:'top'} gets a runtime error with no schema-level warning. Required inspection of runtime_ops.py to determine correct format.
friction_points.evidence: Two retries: attempt 1 output_path error; attempt 2 direction vector error. Fixed by reading source.

friction_points.title: rhino_capture_views output_path must be a .png file path, not a directory
friction_points.description: The parameter name 'output_path' implies a file path but an operator might naturally pass a directory, expecting individual files to be named automatically. The error message is clear but the schema description could state this explicitly.
friction_points.evidence: First capture attempt failed: 'output_path must end in .png'.

friction_points.title: rhino_create_document has no name parameter
friction_points.description: The tool creates a document with a UUID-based temp name. There is no way to set a semantic name (e.g., RHINO_CHATGPT_BRIDGE_POC_004) at creation time. Identity must be established separately via save_as or document user strings.

friction_points.title: rhino_save_as does not update active_document_path in Rhino GUI
friction_points.description: After rhino_save_as, the document's path in Rhino's GUI remains the original temp path. This is technically correct (SaveAs behavior) but can confuse an operator who expects the GUI to reflect the new canonical path after save.
friction_points.evidence: active_document_path_after remains temp TMPDIR path despite successful save to .bridge/artifacts/.

QUICK_WINS.title: Document rhino_capture_views direction vector format with examples
QUICK_WINS.description: Add to tool description or operator guide: views require {'name':'iso', 'direction':[1,1,1], 'up':[0,0,1]} format, not preset name strings. Include four standard view examples (iso, top, front, right) with their direction vectors.

QUICK_WINS.title: Clarify rhino_capture_views output_path semantics in schema
QUICK_WINS.description: Update description to state explicitly: output_path is the contact sheet file path and must end in .png. Individual view PNGs are written alongside it automatically.

PROTOCOL_CHANGES.title: Add full-quit-and-relaunch requirement to operator checklist
PROTOCOL_CHANGES.description: The proof that fresh-relaunch fixes the user-scope MCP loading issue is now established. Add to operator.md: after any MCP config change, quit Claude Code fully before the next POC run. Verify with ListMcpResourcesTool as the first action of each session.

MCP_RUNTIME_CHANGES.title: Add optional name parameter to rhino_create_document
MCP_RUNTIME_CHANGES.description: Allow operators to set a semantic document name at creation time rather than relying on save_as to establish identity.

MCP_RUNTIME_CHANGES.title: Support named view presets in rhino_capture_views
MCP_RUNTIME_CHANGES.description: Accept preset strings like 'iso', 'top', 'front', 'right' as shorthand for standard direction vectors, with explicit vectors as override. This aligns the parameter name 'preset' in the tool schema with actual behavior.
